en.title: Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 Announced for English Release!
en.text: The English edition of Adachi and Shimamura Volume 13 is set to go on sale in North America on October 20, 2026, published by Airship. The 224-page light novel features story and art by Hitoma Iruma, raemz, and Non. Titled "Putting on a Show," the volume follows Adachi and Shimamura as third-year students who somehow completely forgot about the Culture Festival until they were invited to participate. Although the event will only last a couple of days, it seems Adachi has something a little extra in mind.

en.title: Volume SS3 Announced!
en.text: Adachi to Shimamura's third short story collection goes on sale in Japan on September 10. Alongside "Her Memories," which follows a trip the two take as university students, this volume includes many newly written stories about their everyday life at home, at the supermarket, and even overseas.
